risks.description: No independently ratified ADR-ENG-003/004 or proposed ADR-ENG-005; trust-domain identity decision is code-consistent but issuer governance is open.
risks.mitigation: Independent architectural review with exact SHA, canonical 19-owner semantic contract, six quarantined adapters, SPIFFE naming and bounded v1/v2 vs proposed v3.

risks.description: No authenticated qualified independent Security signoff for JWT/mTLS/SQL/RLS/ENG14 threat model; local CI test roots are not managed PKI.
risks.mitigation: Name real independent reviewer; assess code and threat model now, provider PKI/physical SSL after authorized provisioning; sign exact SHA/artifact digest.

risks.description: No human verified qualification, professional source legal rights, contraindication SOP and scoped review; ENG06 remains bounded synthetic only.
risks.mitigation: Obtain external credential verification, reference rights and professional decision tied to service/jurisdiction and artifact hash; never simulate approval.

risks.description: Owner explicitly forbids independent staging deployment/provisioning pending cost and provider approval; zero actual private services discovered.
risks.mitigation: No deployment. Prepare compatible private provider/region/plan/spend cap/billing/operator/rollback decision only; require explicit written owner consent to resume.

risks.description: Externally managed service certificate issuer, human OIDC/JWKS, nonshared SPIFFE issuance, clientcert physical PostgreSQL authentication and trust rotation not provisioned.
risks.mitigation: Review PKI/key custody and protocol offline; after authorized infrastructure, prove physical sessions, ACL, rotation/revocation and negative tests from provider logs.

risks.description: Docker-bridge isolation does not prove actual external private VLAN, egress allowlist, DNS/direct-IP denial, managed-service fault independence.
risks.mitigation: Prove actual provider routes and denied cross-boundary connections, service crash, peer survival, fail closed and no public fallback after deployment authorization.

risks.description: Old 80-gate ledger has no gate-specific attestations; green 752-test foundation does not establish individual production acceptance.
risks.mitigation: Use v1 supplemental 80-gate file for exact test-method/job/SHA mappings, flag missing evidence, obtain signed adjudications and targeted regressions as needed.

risks.description: 100 local synthetic E2E samples (p95 3.481149s, p99 3.534534s) are not production SLA/actual model-image load; unpinned runner class.
risks.mitigation: Independently ratify SLO, workload, error budget and performance targets; run target private provider later; CI numbers remain candidate evidence.

risks.description: Offline synthetic alert rules and SQLite backup are not real managed Postgres PITR/RTO/RPO, pager ACK, on-call/rollback.
risks.mitigation: Review runbook and targets now; execute provider restore, alert delivery and rollback drill after authorized environment; sign measured results.

risks.description: Read-only consent preflight returns HTTP501 and cannot grant atomic media-write permission; future writer could have revoke TOCTOU if enabled without transactional check.
risks.mitigation: Keep media ingestion DISABLED in synthetic A2. Before any real image capability, implement writer-side same-transaction consent/session/version/qualification recheck, retention/deletion and negative race tests.

risks.description: Independent author/implementer separation, reviewer credentials, signed exact-commit verdict and expiry/waiver controls are not evidenced.
risks.mitigation: Request human Architecture, Security, SRE, professional reviews with original signatures, scope and artifact digests; no AI self-attestation.

risks.description: Legacy ENG19 review transport might be mistaken for canonical ENG-19 automation or v2 alias might bypass protected service ownership.
risks.mitigation: Explicitly segregate LEGACY_REVIEW_TRANSPORT as noncanonical scope and keep six A1 adapters read-only/quarantined until signed ADR.

risks.description: ENG06 could be incorrectly promoted from bounded synthetic reviewer to real treatment advice or ENG07 dispatch on green CI.
risks.mitigation: Hard freeze release=false, no customer information, no staged auto-dispatch; a separate professional, privacy, Security and owner-approved release PR is mandatory.

risks.description: The new decision packet SHA differs from the previously tested code SHA; source changes might accidentally inherit old green CI labels.
risks.mitigation: Validate six baseline run SHAs and 80 gate paths/tests; enforce git diff from tested SHA contains only governance/validation/docs. Re-run affected code tests on any runtime change.
